The “super influencers” powering the post-Trump right

August 31, 2026

Zack Beauchamp, Vox, August 31, 2026

Share

Aaron Renn was in a good mood. And that was fair: It’s not every day that you get labeled the No. 1 “intellectual super influencer” for a major swath of the Trump-era right.

“It’s always good to have some independent validation of your work,” he told me.
